Ce plugin doit être approuvé par NeoDex: This plugin must be approved by NeoDex to open.
Change le format de tes fichiers : gliss: Change your files' format: drag them in, pick the output format, and the converted file is created next to the original, never overwritten. Images (PNG, JPG, WebP, ICO, AVIF…), sounds (MP3, WAV, FLAC…), videos (MP4, WebM, animated GIF, audio only), spreadsheets (Excel, ODS, CSV, JSON) and documents (Word, Markdown, HTML to PDF). Adjustable size, quality and square crop; ffmpeg required for media.
Images, sons, vidéos, tableaux (Excel, O: Images, sounds, videos, tables (Excel, ODS, CSV, JSON) and documents (Word, Markdown, HTML, text → PDF, etc.). The converted file is created alongside the original, which is never modified.
La taille, la qualité et le recadrage s': Size, quality, and cropping apply to images and videos.
Rien n'est synchronisé : les fichiers co: Nothing is synchronized: the converted files remain on the PC.
ffmpeg introuvable : seuls les tableaux: ffmpeg not found: only tables and documents can be converted.
